The scene depicts a parent and child engaged in reading a storybook on a tablet. The child appears to be [hesitant], showing uncertainty before starting to read. The parent initiates reading and encourages the child to start reading the storybook.

The parent uses verbal prompts and encouragement to guide the child through the reading activity. The child's eventual engagement in reading, albeit with parental support, indicates that the strategy is effective in gradually building the child's confidence and willingness to participate.

Parent Strategy was [Largely Successful]. The parent successfully encouraged the hesitant child to start reading by providing reassurance and step-by-step guidance.
